stem:
A survey of visitors at a national park was conducted to determine the preferred activity of each visitor to the park. Each visitor chose one activity. The survey results are shown in the table.

Preferred Activities

| Activity       | Number of Visitors |
|----------------|--------------------|
| Camping        | 28                 |
| Hiking Trails  | 22                 |
| Water Sports   | 14                 |
| Biking Trails  | 16                 |

Based on this information, which prediction about the preferred activity for the next 200 visitors to the park is the most reasonable?

options.label: A
options.text: The number of visitors who prefer water sports will be 5 more than the number of visitors who prefer biking trails.

options.label: B
options.text: The number of visitors who prefer hiking trails will be 8 more than the number of visitors who prefer water sports.

options.label: C
options.text: The number of visitors who prefer camping will be 15 times the number of visitors who prefer hiking trails.

options.label: D
options.text: The number of visitors who prefer camping will be 2 times the number of visitors who prefer water sports.
